ex.en: They shall not create warmth by the cold roke of the fire, but by eaglewood on coals.
ex.roman: lā yaṣṭalīna duḵāna n-nāri šātiyatan … ʔillā biʕūdi yalanjūjin ʕalā faḥmi

ex.ar: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِ فَغَشِيَهُمْ مِنَ الْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
ex.en: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his hosts, and they were overwhelmed by the sea that enshrouded them.
ex.roman: faʔatbaʕahum firʕawnu bijunūdihi faḡašiyahum mina al-yammi mā ḡašiyahum

senses.gloss: names for doves or pigeons, especially Streptopelia of which especially Streptopelia risoria, Columba oenas and Columba livia
to intend, to purpose, to betake oneself to

ex.ar: ثُمَّ ٱنْعَطِفْ يَمِينًا.
ex.en: Then, turn right.

ex.ar: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَا مُوسَى
ex.en: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?

senses.gloss: January (first month of the Gregorian calendar)
Yanbu (a major port city in Al Madinah Province, Saudi Arabia)

ex.ar: وَقَالُوا لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّى تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ الأَرْضِ يَنْبُوعًا
ex.en: And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring."
ex.roman: wa-qālū lan nuʔmina laka ḥattā tafjura lanā mina l-ʔarḍi yanbūʕan

ex.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللّٰهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَلَكَهُ يَنَابِيعَ فِي الأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ حُطَامًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَى لِأُولِي الأَلْبَابِ
ex.en: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
ex.roman: ʔalam tara ʔanna llāha ʔanzala mina s-samāʔi māʔan fa-salakahu yanābīʕa fī l-ʔarḍi ṯumma yuḵriju bihi zarʕan muḵtalifan ʔalwānuhu ṯumma yahīju fa-tarāhu muṣfarran ṯumma yajʕaluhu ḥuṭāman ʔinna fī ḏālika la-ḏikrā li-ʔūlī l-ʔalbābi

ex.ar: «درستُ إلى الصف الثالث الابتدائي». قلت: «إذاً أنتِ تعرفين القراءة والكتابة؟». ردّت: «يه».
ex.en: “I went to schol till the third elementary grade.” I said: “You know to read and write, then?” She replied: “Aye.”

ex.ar: وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ وَٱلنَّصَارَىٰ نَحْنُ أَبْنَاءُ ٱللَّهِ وَأَحِبَّاؤُهُ ۚ قُلْ فَلِمَ يُعَذِّبُكُم بِذُنُوبِكُم ۖ بَلْ أَنتُم بَشَرٌ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ex.en: The Jews and Christians say: We are sons of Allah and His loved ones. Say: Why then doth He chastise you for your sins? Nay, ye are but mortals of His creating. He forgiveth whom He will, and chastiseth whom He will. Allah's is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and unto Him is the journeying.
ex.roman: wa-qālati l-yahūdu wa-n-aṣārā naḥnu ʾabnāʾu llāhi wa-ʾaḥibbāʾuh[ū], qul fa-lima yuʿaḏḏibukum bi-ḏunūbikum, bal ʾantum bašarum-mimman ḵalaq[a], yaġfiru li-man yašāʾu wa-yuʿaḏḏibu man yašāʾ[u], wa-llāhi mulku s-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wa-mā baynahumā, wa-ʾilayhi l-maṣīr[u]

senses.gloss: Judas (Iscariot), one of the Twelve Disciples of Jesus (who betrayed him for thirty pieces of silver)
Jude, one of the Twelve Disciples of Jesus
Jude, the penultimate book of the New Testament
Utah (a state in the western United States)
Yugoslavia (a former country in Southeastern Europe in the Balkans, now split into 6 countries: Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Serbia, and Slovenia)
Any of the New Testament figures named John

ex.ar: يُوحَنَّا الْمَعْمَدَانُ
ex.en: John the Baptist

ex.ar: يُوحَنَّا الْإِنْجِيلِيُّ
ex.en: John the Evangelist

senses.gloss: John, the last of the four canonical gospels
a male given name, equivalent to English John

ex.ar: يُوسُفُ أَيُّهَا الصِّدِّيقُ أَفْتِنَا فِي سَبْعِ بَقَرَاتٍ سِمَانٍ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌ وَسَبْعِ سُنْبُلَاتٍ خُضْرٍ وَأُخَرَ يَابِسَاتٍ لَعَلِّي أَرْجِعُ إِلَى النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
ex.en: “Joseph, O man of truth, explain to us about seven fat cows eaten by seven lean, and seven green ears of grain and others dry – that I may return to the people; perhaps they will know [about you].”
ex.roman: yūsufu ʔayyuhā ṣ-ṣiddīqu ʔaftinā fī sabʕi baqarātin simānin yaʔkuluhunna sabʕun ʕijāfun wa-sabʕi sunbulātin ḵuḍrin wa-ʔuḵara yābisātin laʕallī ʔarjiʕu ʔilā n-nāsi laʕallahum yaʕlamūna

senses.gloss: Joseph, husband of Mary (mother of Jesus)
a male given name, Yusuf, Yousef, Yousif, Youssef, Youssif, Yousuf, or Yusef, equivalent to English Joseph
July (seventh month of the Gregorian calendar)
day, period from sunrise to sunset

ex.ar: أَذْهَبُ إِلَى ٱلْمَدْرَسَةِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
ex.en: I go to school every day.

ex.ar: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى الْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَى كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
ex.en: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
ex.roman: saḵḵarahā ʕalayhim sabʕa layālin wa-ṯamāniyata ʔayyāmin ḥusūman fa-tarā l-qawma fīhā ṣarʕā kaʔannahum ʔaʕjāzu naḵlin ḵāwiyatin

ex.ar: فِي يَوْمٍ مِنَ الْأَيَّامِ
ex.en: once (in the past), once upon a time

ex.ar: يُوفُونَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيرًا
ex.en: They fulfil [their] vows and fear a Day of sweeping horror,
ex.roman: yūfūna bi-n-naḏri wa-yaḵāfūna yawman kāna šarruhu mustaṭīran

ex.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَاهَا
ex.en: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
ex.roman: kaʔannahum yawma yarawnahā lam yalbaṯū ʔillā ʕašiyyatan ʔaw ḍuḥāhā

ex.ar: مَـٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ex.en: Master of the Day of Judgement

senses.gloss: Yom Kippur, the Jewish Day of Atonement.
day of judgement, judgment day (especially in Islamic contexts)

ex.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
ex.en: Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding the things they differed about.
ex.roman: ʔinna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yaḵtalifūna

ex.ar: بَلۡ یُرِیدُ ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنُ لِیَفۡجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ. ٦. یَسۡـَٔلُ "أَیَّانَ یَوۡمُ ٱلۡقِیَـٰمَةِ؟"
ex.en: But man would fain deny what is before him. 6. He asketh: "When will be this Day of Resurrection?"

senses.gloss: Yom Kippur, the Jewish Day of Atonement.
once (in the past), once upon a time

ex.ar: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِي مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ بِبَنِيهِ
ex.en: They will be shown each other; the criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
ex.roman: yubaṣṣarūnahum yawaddu l-mujrimu law yaftadī min ʕaḏābi yawmiʔiḏin bi-banīhi
